title: Moriarty the Patriot
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In Victorian England, a brilliant orphan adopted into the cruel Moriarty noble family, with his brother Louis and the eldest son Albert, sets a deadly fire that kills the rest of the family. As Professor William James Moriarty, he becomes a 'consulting criminal' who orchestrates the deaths of corrupt aristocrats to break Britain's class system, eventually crossing paths with Sherlock Holmes. A reimagining of Conan Doyle's villain as an anti-hero.
life_message: It holds up tearing down an unjust class system, while asking whether the murders done for it can ever be justified.
